blurb: Liebenzell Retreat Ministries is a Christian retreat center located on Schooley’s Mountain. Conveniently located in central New Jersey about 1 ½ hrs from New York and Philadelphia, we provide a beautiful and refreshing environment for groups and individuals to grow in and experience the transformational love of Jesus Christ.
